label: Initial fertility normalization
data: Author-imposed stationary model normalization, not an empirical estimate.
model: The existing normalization solves for the fertility utility scale; no weight in the twelve-row objective.
assessment: Keep its role explicit. Do not interpret 2.1 as a directly measured period birth rate or equate it with every cohort fertility measure.

label: Childless women, ages 40-44
data: June CPS 2004/2006, women 40-44, valid children-ever-born and positive fertility-supplement weight; weighted share with zero children. Saved source estimate reproduced.
model: Uniform birth-time interpolation across four-year age cells, with fractional overlap at 40-44; uses the model household reproductive-member mass.
assessment: Age mapper is implemented. Female population and empirical/model age composition need an explicit common interpretation.

label: Exactly one child among mothers
data: Same CPS sample; weighted share with exactly one child conditional on ever having a child.
model: Exactly-one-child stock divided by the stock of mothers, using the same age projection.
assessment: This is not a second-birth hazard. Reconcile population mapping alongside childlessness; no unavailable-mapper claim.

label: Mean first-birth age
data: NCHS first-birth counts 2003-2006. Ages are mapped to the model midpoint classes; tails below 18 and above 45 are absorbed into boundary groups. Saved estimate reproduced.
model: First-birth flow weighted mean of model age-cell midpoints in the stationary economy.
assessment: Same grouped-age calculation is available. Stationary versus dated period, population/residence scope and boundary support remain explicit assumptions.

label: First births at age 30 or above
data: Share of pooled first births at exact maternal age 30 or above, among the saved age 12-49 counts.
model: Share of model first-birth flow in cells beginning at 30 or above.
assessment: Threshold matches a model cell boundary. Period/population and support assumptions still require a declared target interpretation.

label: Aggregate wealth / annual earnings
data: National PSID 2003/2005: weighted total net worth of reference-person families 18-85 divided by weighted gross labor earnings for working-age families. Ratio of sums, not mean household ratio.
model: Beginning net financial wealth plus owner housing value, divided by annualized gross model labor earnings. Four-year flows are annualized once and payroll tax is grossed up.
assessment: Arithmetic and annualization are verified. Reconcile mortgage/net-worth components and stock versus income reference dates before treating this as an exact empirical counterpart.

label: Annual bequests / aggregate wealth
data: Inherited external historical restriction. No in-repository microdata builder or empirical SE; this review verifies its stored value, not its primary-source derivation.
model: Expected nonnegative estate flows at death, annualized once, divided by aggregate beginning wealth; terminal death is imposed.
assessment: Verify the source definition and accept or revise the external restriction explicitly. Its 5% tolerance is synthetic, not estimated precision. No automatic dropping: preserve bequest-block identification.

label: Old wealth/income p90 / median
data: National PSID 2003/2005 reference persons 76-84, family income above $1000 and observed child history. Weighted 90th percentile of net-worth/family-income divided by its weighted median.
model: Same quantile operation and explicit 76-84 cell overlap, but income is modeled pension plus configured transfer. The scorer unambiguously uses this observer, not the legacy label-age statistic.
assessment: Family income contains components absent from the pension proxy. Income threshold, observed-history selection and wealth components need reconciliation. This is a substantive mapping issue, not an ambiguous active scorer.

label: Mean occupied rooms, cap 9
data: ACS 2005/2006, selected 42 MET 2013 metros, household heads 18-85 and the saved housing-validity filters. Weighted rooms capped at 9. Reproduced exactly.
model: Current realized owner/renter rooms capped at 9 in every income-resolved state before aggregation. Fractional age exposure is implemented.
assessment: Cap/order implementation is verified. Decide national versus 42 metros and define the represented housing sample. Saved national counterpart is 5.607886.

label: Ownership, heads 30-55
data: ACS 2005/2006 heads 30-55 in 42 metros, positive household weights and the specified occupied-unit/structure sample. Weighted ownership share; reproduced exactly.
model: Current realized owner mass over total mass, with half of the 54-57 cell included. No whole-cell age-mask error.
assessment: Within-cell age uniformity is explicit. Geography and ACS structure types need a model interpretation. Saved national counterpart is 67.6260%; switching geography does not cure low ownership.

label: First-birth room response
data: Weighted national PSID household-aligned event study: coefficient at +3 minus coefficient at -1, omitted -2; person/year effects, age/education controls and person clustering. Stored scalar and SE reproduce.
model: Matched treated/control branches advanced one four-year period under stationary policies, with destination continuation births allowed; uncapped rooms. This implemented calculation is not the same regression/cohort weighting.
assessment: Not a settled target. Reference support and demonstrated normalization sensitivity remain; author preferred a -2 empirical baseline. Completed binned diagnostic 0.426502 is a different sample/design and is not a replacement. Fix the empirical estimand and model counterpart together.

label: Rooms: 3+ versus 1-2 resident children
data: ACS heads 30-55 with youngest resident own child under 18; compare all resident-own-child counts 3+ versus 1-2, with rooms capped 9. Exact saved reproduction.
model: Model current dependents 3+ versus 1-2, restricted to feasible count states; caps full-state rooms before aggregation.
assessment: Resident own children can include adult children; current dependents with stochastic departure are not that exact grouping. Choose and justify the shared measurement.

label: Recent-parent ownership gap
data: ACS heads 30-55: ownership where oldest resident own child is under 4 minus ownership with no resident own children. Exact saved reproduction.
model: Synchronized current births from previously empty-dependent homes minus current empty homes, including former parents. This is the active repaired observer.
assessment: Not the obsolete lifetime-childless comparison. It remains an approximation to an interview stock defined by oldest child age. Sampling uncertainty alone does not measure this discrepancy. National counterpart 12.7608 pp is available.
